text:
API Request Failures from 14:02 to 14:31 UTC

Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 responses.

A deploy started the incident at 14:02 UTC. The deploy removed the cache warmup step. The missing step caused the API failures.

At 14:27 UTC, we reverted the deploy. The revert restored the cache warmup step. The API returned to its normal error rate at 14:31 UTC.

This incident did not affect requests outside the stated period. We will add a deployment control that makes sure that every deploy runs the cache warmup step. We will also add an alert for a missing cache warmup step.
